lines.text: {detail}

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Match three light side by side, or draw through five actual matching stars. Large stars count as one star, worth two light.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Your sky is paused. Resume when you're ready.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clear a matching group beside the dark star to dissolve it.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Match three light side by side, or five actual stars linked sideways or diagonally. Large stars count as one star, worth two light.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Sky paused. Clear at your pace or call the next shower.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clear matching stars before the columns fill.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: First Light complete! {score} starlight collected. Replay it or start a new sky.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: There was no room for the next star. {score} starlight collected.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: +{score} starlight. A little more room to breathe.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: +{score} starlight. {dark} dissolved.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: A dark star blocks nearby growth. Clear beside it to dissolve it.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {growth} — worth 2 when cleared.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {arrival}. Make room for the next shower.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Same sky, a fresh start. Start when you're ready.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: A new sky. Start when you're ready.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Collect 18 starlight to complete First Light. Start the sky or call a shower.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Balance updated. Your sky is ready when you are.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: A little wonder. A little room to breathe.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clear matching stars. Make room for more.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Gather 18 starlight before the sky fills.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {score} starlight, gathered by you.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {score} starlight gathered. Every sky tells a different story.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Welcome to the Observatory. I'll help you find your way.

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Look up! There's always something to discover.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: A little room makes a big difference.

lines.speaker: twinkle
lines.text: Take your time. Every little light counts.

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: A quieter moment. Let's enjoy it.

lines.speaker: dusk
lines.text: Even the dark has a place in the sky.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {detail}

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clear a matching group containing a captive to close the hole.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clear beside an attraction field to dispel it, or clear between two fields to form a hole.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Start on a colored star. The Opal Orb can join that color’s match or constellation and is spent when cleared.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: An Opal Orb arrived. Start on a colored star to include it in that family’s match or constellation. Clearing spends the orb.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Attraction fields formed. Clear their middle to form a hole, or clear beside an isolated field to dispel it.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Orbit: {windows} windows left. Clear a captive to release the others.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: The hole closed. Its stars are free.

lines.text: {phase}

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: {cadence}

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: {phase}. {cadence}

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: A little wonder. A little room to breathe. {summary}

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {score}. {reason}

lines.speaker: nova
lines.text: {detail} {context}

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clear a matching group beside Dusk to dissolve it, or let it feed for five showers to swallow touching stars for space. Gray stars still match but score zero.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Dusk drains touching stars. After five feeding showers, it swallows them for space, without points. Clear beside it to save their light.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Dusk swallowed {stars} stars for space. No starlight was earned. The remaining stars settle before this shower arrives.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: {growth}. Gray stars still match and grow, but score zero until Dusk is gone.
